items.observation: Because passing rules are recorded as info findings (report.dart:44-48; conformance.dart:127-131), `--fail-on info` returns 1 for every server. The README describes this as 'lowers the bar', and the action also offers the `info` option.
items.proposed_fix: Define the meaning of the info threshold: either remove the `info` option or separate observation from passing. Add tests, update the README and action.yml.
items.closure_criteria: Either the info option is removed from bin/mcp_probe.dart, README.md and action.yml or passing observations no longer fail the run. Tests cover the chosen behavior and the CI action job stays green.

items.observation: There is no unit test for flag parsing, exit codes (0/1/64/70), and `_shouldFail`. Only the CI action job checks a single non-zero exit case (ci.yaml:43-49).
items.proposed_fix: Move `_shouldFail` and `_severity` to lib/src (for example a threshold method on the report) and test them. Add Process.run based tests for flags and exit codes.
items.closure_criteria: _shouldFail and _severity move to lib/src, for example as a threshold method on the report, with unit tests. Process.run based tests cover flag parsing and the exit codes 0, 1, 64 and 70.

items.observation: `_checkMethodNotFound` catches only RpcException and TimeoutException. Any other error (the connection closing, or the TypeError of the cast at harness.dart:368 when the result is not an object) propagates out of checkServer and breaks the 'server data → finding' contract at 118-120. The sibling rules (235, 350, 382, 406) catch everything.
items.proposed_fix: Add the same 'turn every error into a finding' branch. Write a test with a fixture server that returns a non-object result for an unknown method.
items.closure_criteria: _checkMethodNotFound turns every error into a finding like its sibling rules. A fixture server returning a non-object result for an unknown method backs a test.

items.observation: The 10000 page limit and the 2 s kill stages are written as fixed literals. They are not named and documented like stderrCap and stdoutNoiseCap (52-56).
items.proposed_fix: Use a named static const with dartdoc, or derive the value from `killAfter`.
items.closure_criteria: The 10000 page limit and the 2 s kill stages are named static const values with dartdoc or derive from killAfter.

items.observation: Places that turn an error into a finding or a handshake exception use `catch (e)`. This trips the shared typed catch rule (J10, D11). bin/mcp_probe.dart:67 already uses `on Object catch`.
items.proposed_fix: `on Object catch` with a one-line rationale.
items.closure_criteria: All listed catch sites read on Object catch with a one-line rationale comment.
